scripts.title: AYUSH SPAMMER
scripts.features:
👑 AYUSH SPAMMER ⚡🥶👑

A lightweight, all-in-one chat spammer GUI with
message editing, multi-target support, and RX
Chat loader integration. No key system.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

✦ HOW IT WORKS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
The script creates a draggable on-screen panel
with the following controls:

🎯 TARGET     — Who the message is directed at
✏️ SYMBOL     — Character used as prefix (default @)
🔢 COUNT      — Number of symbols per message
⏱️ SPEED      — Delay between messages (seconds)

When START is pressed, the loop takes each
message from the list, prepends the symbol
repeated N times, wraps the target name in
brackets, and sends it through the active
chat system (TextChatService or legacy).

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

✦ FEATURES
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
✅ Drag-able GUI with minimize button
✅ 18 preloaded messages (fully editable)
✅ Message Editor — add / edit / delete / save
✅ Auto-saving to ayush_messages.json
✅ MULTI TARGET panel — 10 slots (5×2 grid)
✅ Auto-detects filled slots → enables MULTI
✅ Cycles through only filled targets
✅ Compatible with TextChatService & legacy chat
✅ One-click RX Chat loader integration
✅ No key system / no external dependencies

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

✦ MULTI TARGET SYSTEM
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Open the MULTI panel → type up to 10 target
names in the slots. Any filled slot auto-
enables MULTI mode, and the spam loop cycles
through only the filled targets. Blank slots
are ignored. The Target box locks while MULTI
is active. Click "CLEAR ALL" to reset.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

✦ MESSAGE EDITOR
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Click 📝 EDIT to open the editor.
  ➕ ADD  — adds a new blank message row
  ✕       — deletes that row
  💾 SAVE — writes everything to the JSON
            file and closes the editor
Messages persist between sessions via
writefile/readfile (executor required).

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

✦ RX CHAT BUTTON
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Clicking 💬 RX CHAT fetches the RX Chat script
from its GitHub source, loads it, and executes
it in the same environment. Status shows
success or failure. No permanent modification
is made to your files.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

✦ REQUIREMENTS

⚠️ USE RESPONSIBLY — chat spam can get you

scripts.title: CATWALK ANIMATION COMBO
scripts.features:
CATWALK — Animation Combo
This script replaces the character’s default movement animations with a custom animation combination:
🕺 Idle: Catwalk
🚶 Walk: Adidas Aura
🏃 Run: Adidas Aura
🦘 Jump: Adidas Aura
🪽 Fall: Adidas Aura
⚙️ How it works
Detects your character
The script waits for your Humanoid and creates/uses its Animator.
Resolves the animation IDs
The gRId() function attempts to resolve each supplied animation ID and caches successful results so they don't need to be resolved repeatedly.
Loads the animations
Each resolved animation is loaded onto your character and given high Action4 priority so it can override lower-priority movement animations.
Monitors your movement
A Heartbeat loop continuously checks the Humanoid's current state:
Standing → Catwalk idle
Moving → Adidas Aura walk
Jumping → Adidas Aura jump
Falling → Adidas Aura fall
Smoothly switches animations
When the required animation changes, other currently playing tracks are stopped and the appropriate track is played.
Handles respawning
When your character respawns, the script automatically runs the setup again and reloads the animation combination.
🔥 Result
You get a Catwalk + Adidas Aura hybrid animation pack without manually changing animations:
CATWALK IDLE → ADIDAS AURA WALK/RUN/JUMP/FALL
The script also prints loading/resolution information in the executor console so you can see whether each animation was successfully resolved.

    local NotifMsg = Instance.new("TextLabel")

    NotifMsg.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

    TweenService:Create(NotifFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)}):Play()

        local tweenOut = TweenService:Create(NotifFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {BackgroundTransparency = 1})

-- Fitur Dragging TopBar
-- =======================================================
-- SISTEM DRAGGING DENGAN TOGGLE ON / OFF
-- =======================================================
local isDraggable = false -- Status default drag: OFF
local dragging, dragStart, startPos

TopBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    -- Mengecek apakah fitur dragging sedang diaktifkan (ON)
    if not isDraggable then return end
    
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = TopBar.Position
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if dragging and isDraggable and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        TopBar.Position = UDim2.new(
            startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = false
    end
end)

-- Multi-Tab Manager

    TabStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(50, 90, 200)
    TabStroke.Thickness = 1
    TabStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
    TabStroke.Parent = TabButton

    local Dropdown = Instance.new("Frame")

    Dropdown.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
    Dropdown.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 20, 48)
    Dropdown.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
    Dropdown.BorderSizePixel = 0
    Dropdown.ClipsDescendants = true
    Dropdown.Parent = TabButton

    local DropdownStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    DropdownStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(50, 90, 200)
    DropdownStroke.Thickness = 1
    DropdownStroke.Parent = Dropdown

    local DropdownLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
    DropdownLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    DropdownLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 2)
    DropdownLayout.Parent = Dropdown

    local currentHeight = 0
    local TabElements = {}

    local function updateHeight(delta)
        currentHeight = currentHeight + delta
        if activeDropdown == Dropdown then
            TweenService:Create(Dropdown, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, currentHeight)}):Play()
        end
    end

    -- Toggle Buka/Tutup
    TabButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        if activeDropdown and activeDropdown ~= Dropdown then
            TweenService:Create(activeDropdown, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)}):Play()
        end

        if activeDropdown == Dropdown then
            TweenService:Create(Dropdown, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)}):Play()

GhostDummy 1.10 is a Ghost Drivers autofarm script, supporting Voss RT10 TT (Audi R8-inspired), Valhalla GT and Wulfbrecht RZ7. It includes continuous driving, adjustable speed, location shortcuts, an owned-car spawn tool and a customizable sidebar GUI. Local RGB and rainbow paint currently support Valhalla GT and RZ7.

WHAT’S NEW IN VERSION 1.10?
• Added Voss RT10 TT to Driving and Garage
• Dedicated RT10 TT driving profile with targets up to 301 dashboard MPH
• Existing Valhalla GT and RZ7 driving profiles retained
• Five separate tabs: Driving, Locations, Garage, Paint and Settings

WHAT DOES GHOSTDUMMY DO?
• Continuous autofarm with simple ON/OFF control
• Physical route assistance and recovery from recoverable driving interruptions
• Cruise, Fast, Max and custom MPH targets
• Speed adjustments while driving
• F8 emergency stop
• Idle protection during continuous driving where supported by the executor

GHOST DRIVERS LOCATION SHORTCUTS

Open Locations to travel to the dealership, customization pads, highway race or gas station. Driving must be OFF and you must exit your car first. These shortcuts move your character, not your vehicle.

SPAWN YOUR FASTEST SUPPORTED OWNED CAR

Garage checks your owned Valhalla GT, Wulfbrecht RZ7 and Voss RT10 TT, then selects the car with the highest listed speed. Upgrades are not ranked. It does not buy cars or start driving automatically.

RGB PAINT AND RAINBOW CAR COLORS

For Valhalla GT and Wulfbrecht RZ7, Paint includes six presets, custom RGB values, continuous full-spectrum rainbow cycling, a 2–30 second cycle period and restore-original controls. Voss RT10 TT paint is not yet supported.

Paint changes your local view only; it is not saved as a game upgrade and visibility to other players is not guaranteed. Paint runs independently of driving. Switching Driving OFF leaves an active effect running. Rainbow OFF, Restore original or F8 restores tracked original colors. Active paint effects do not automatically resume on reload.

CUSTOMIZABLE SCRIPT GUI

Use separate Driving, Locations, Garage, Paint and Settings tabs. Resize the glass-style panel, adjust opacity and text weight, and change the hide/show keybind. Right Shift is the default. Includes saved preferences, key caching where storage is available, Discord access and in-script bug reports with optional technical information.

HOW DO I GET A FREE GHOST DRIVERS SCRIPT KEY?

Run the loader and select Get key. Choose LootLabs, Work.ink or Linkvertise, complete the provider’s tasks, then paste the issued key into GhostDummy. Free keys last 72 hours from issuance and bind to one Roblox account on first successful use.

WHICH CARS AND EXECUTORS ARE SUPPORTED?

Driving and Garage support Voss RT10 TT, Valhalla GT and Wulfbrecht RZ7. Paint supports Valhalla GT and RZ7. Live feature checks were performed on MacSploit. Windows, mobile and other executors remain unverified; a visible GUI alone does not confirm driving compatibility.


Speed settings are targets, not guarantees. The RT10 TT’s 301 MPH cap does not guarantee that speed will be reached or sustained.

		local shadowModel = Instance.new("Model")
		shadowModel.Name = "R6ShadowMonster"

		local blackColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
		local plasticMat = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic

		local function createLimb(name, size)
			local part = Instance.new("Part")
			part.Name = name
			part.Size = size
			part.Color = blackColor
			part.Material = plasticMat
			part.CanCollide = false
			part.Anchored = true
			part.Parent = shadowModel

		end

		local torso = createLimb("Torso", Vector3.new(2, 2, 1))
		local head = createLimb("Head", Vector3.new(1.2, 1.2, 1.2))
		local leftArm = createLimb("Left Arm", Vector3.new(1, 2, 1))
		local rightArm = createLimb("Right Arm", Vector3.new(1, 2, 1))

		local rightLeg = createLimb("Right Leg", Vector3.new(1, 2, 1))

		eye1.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
		eye1.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
		eye1.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
		eye1.CanCollide = false
		eye1.Anchored = true
		eye1.Parent = shadowModel

		local eye2 = eye1:Clone()
		eye2.Name = "RightEye"
		eye2.Parent = shadowModel

		shadowModel.Parent = ASH.Workspace
		ASH.shadowModel = shadowModel

		local function updateR6CFrame(centerCFrame)
			torso.CFrame = centerCFrame
			head.CFrame = centerCFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1.5, 0)
			leftArm.CFrame = centerCFrame * CFrame.new(-1.5, 0, 0)
			rightArm.CFrame = centerCFrame * CFrame.new(1.5, 0, 0)
			leftLeg.CFrame = centerCFrame * CFrame.new(-0.5, -2, 0)
			rightLeg.CFrame = centerCFrame * CFrame.new(0.5, -2, 0)
			
			eye1.CFrame = head.CFrame * CFrame.new(-0.25, 0.15, -0.6)
			eye2.CFrame = head.CFrame * CFrame.new(0.25, 0.15, -0.6)
		end

		updateR6CFrame(char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -20))

		ASH.shadowThread = task.spawn(function()
			local speed = 10
			while ASH.shadowEntityActive and shadowModel and torso.Parent do
				local dt = ASH.RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
				local pChar = ASH.player.Character
				if pChar and pChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and pChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
					local targetPos = pChar.HumanoidRootPart.Position
					local currentPos = torso.Position
					local direction = (targetPos - currentPos)
					local distance = direction.Magnitude

					if distance > 0.5 then
						local moveDir = direction.Unit
						local newPos = currentPos + (moveDir * speed * dt)
						local nextCFrame = CFrame.new(newPos, targetPos)
						
						updateR6CFrame(nextCFrame)

						if distance <= 3.5 then
							pChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid").Health = 0
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end)

		ASH.StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {Title = "ASH..-AYE Admin", Text = "Black Fog Active! Run!", Duration = 3})
	else
		if ASH.shadowThread then task.cancel(ASH.shadowThread) end
		if ASH.shadowModel then ASH.shadowModel:Destroy() end

		local customAtmos = ASH.Lighting:FindFirstChild("ASH_DarkAtmosphere")
		if customAtmos then customAtmos:Destroy() end

		ASH.Lighting.Brightness = ASH.fogBackup.Brightness or 1
		ASH.Lighting.ClockTime = ASH.fogBackup.ClockTime or 14
		ASH.Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = ASH.fogBackup.OutdoorAmbient or Color3.fromRGB(128, 128, 128)
		ASH.Lighting.FogColor = ASH.fogBackup.FogColor or Color3.fromRGB(192, 192, 192)
		ASH.Lighting.FogEnd = ASH.fogBackup.FogEnd or 100000
		ASH.Lighting.FogStart = ASH.fogBackup.FogStart or 0

		ASH.StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {Title = "ASH..-AYE Admin", Text = "Fog Restored & Monster Despawned.", Duration = 3})
	end

local function httpGet(url)
    local ok, body = pcall(function()
        if syn and syn.request then return syn.request({Url = url, Method = "GET"}).Body
        elseif request then return request({Url = url, Method = "GET"}).Body
        elseif http and http.request then return http.request({Url = url, Method = "GET"}).Body end
        return nil
    end)
    return ok and body or nil
end

local function isMp3(body)
    if not body or #body < 4 then return false end
    local h = body:sub(1, 3)
    if h == "ID3" then return true end
    return body:byte(1) == 0xFF
end

    pcall(writefile, MUSIC_CACHE, body)
    return true
end

local function normalize(name)
    return string.lower(string.gsub(name, "[^%w]", ""))
end

local function buildRig(model)
    local rig = {Character = model, Parts = {}, Motors = {}, Humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")}
    for _, item in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
        if item:IsA("BasePart") then
            if not rig.Parts[item.Name] then rig.Parts[item.Name] = item end
        elseif item:IsA("Motor6D") then
            rig.Motors[normalize(item.Name)] = item
        end
    end
    return rig
end

local function jointPosition(rig, name)
    local motor = rig.Motors[normalize(name)]
    if not motor then return nil end
    if motor.Part0 then return (motor.Part0.CFrame * motor.C0).Position end
    if motor.Part1 then return (motor.Part1.CFrame * motor.C1).Position end
    return nil
end

local function partPosition(rig, name, edge)
    local part = rig.Parts[name]
    if not part then return nil end
    if edge == "top" then return part.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(0, part.Size.Y / 2, 0)) end
    if edge == "bottom" then return part.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(0, -part.Size.Y / 2, 0)) end
    return part.Position
end

local function resolvePoint(rig, key)
    local kind, name = key:match("^([^:]+):(.+)$")
    if not kind then return nil end
    if kind == "joint" then return jointPosition(rig, name) end
    if kind == "top" or kind == "bottom" then return partPosition(rig, name, kind) end
    if kind == "center" then return partPosition(rig, name) end
    return nil
end

local function project(camera, position)
    if not position then return nil end
    local point = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(position)
    if point.Z <= 0 then return nil end
    return Vector2.new(point.X, point.Y), point.Z
end

local function getTracerOrigin(camera)
    local origin = Config.TracerOrigin
    local vp = camera.ViewportSize
    if origin == "Bottom" then return Vector2.new(vp.X / 2, vp.Y)
    elseif origin == "Top" then return Vector2.new(vp.X / 2, 0)
    elseif origin == "Center" then return Vector2.new(vp.X / 2, vp.Y / 2)
    elseif origin == "Mouse" then
        local m = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
        return Vector2.new(m.X, m.Y)
    end
    return Vector2.new(vp.X / 2, vp.Y)
end

local function computeBounds(rig, camera)
    local minX, minY = math.huge, math.huge
    local maxX, maxY = -math.huge, -math.huge
    local boneList = getBones(rig)
    for _, bone in ipairs(boneList) do
        for i = 1, 2 do
            local pos = resolvePoint(rig, bone[i])
            if pos then
                local screenPos = project(camera, pos)
                if screenPos then
                    minX = math.min(minX, screenPos.X)
                    maxX = math.max(maxX, screenPos.X)
                    minY = math.min(minY, screenPos.Y)
                    maxY = math.max(maxY, screenPos.Y)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if minX == math.huge then return nil end
    local padding = 4
    return {
        minX = minX - padding, maxX = maxX + padding,
        minY = minY - padding, maxY = maxY + padding,
    }
end

local function isVisibleFromCamera(targetChar, targetPart)
    local part = targetChar:FindFirstChild(targetPart)
    if not part then return false end
    local origin = Camera.CFrame.Position
    local direction = part.Position - origin
    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {LocalPlayer.Character, targetChar}
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Blacklist
    return Workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, params) == nil
end

local function getPredictedPosition(part, prediction)
    if not part then return nil end
    if prediction <= 0 then return part.Position end
    return part.Position + (part.Velocity * prediction)
end

local aimLastTarget = nil
local aimLastTargetTime = 0

local function aimbotIsValid(char)
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local part = char:FindFirstChild(Config.AimbotPart)
    if not hum or not part or hum.Health <= 0 then return false end
    local plr = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(char)
    if plr and Config.TeamCheck and isTeammate(plr) then return false end
    return true
end

local function aimbotScore(char)
    local part = char:FindFirstChild(Config.AimbotPart)
    if not part then return nil end
    local predicted = getPredictedPosition(part, Config.AimbotPrediction)
    if not predicted then return nil end
    local screenPos, depth = project(Camera, predicted)
    if not screenPos or depth <= 0 then return nil end
    local center = Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, Camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2)
    local dist = (screenPos - center).Magnitude
    if dist > Config.AimbotFOV then return nil end
    if Config.AimbotVisibleOnly then
        if not isVisibleFromCamera(char, Config.AimbotPart) then return nil end
    elseif Config.AimbotWallCheck then
        local origin = Camera.CFrame.Position
        local direction = part.Position - origin
        local params = RaycastParams.new()
        params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {LocalPlayer.Character, char}
        params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Blacklist
        local result = Workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, params)
        if result and result.Instance and not result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(char) then return nil end
    end
    return dist
end

local function aimbotSelectTarget()
    local best, bestScore = nil, math.huge
    for _, char in ipairs(Workspace:GetChildren()) do
        if char:IsA("Model") and char ~= LocalPlayer.Character and aimbotIsValid(char) then
            local score = aimbotScore(char)
            if score and score < bestScore then best, bestScore = char, score end
        end
    end
    local now = tick()
    if best then
        aimLastTarget = best
        aimLastTargetTime = now
        return best
    end
    if aimLastTarget and (now - aimLastTargetTime) < Config.AimbotStickyTime then
        if aimLastTarget.Parent and aimbotIsValid(aimLastTarget) then
            local part = aimLastTarget:FindFirstChild(Config.AimbotPart)
            if part then
                local screenPos, depth = project(Camera, part.Position)
                if screenPos and depth > 0 then
                    local center = Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, Camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2)
                    if (screenPos - center).Magnitude <= Config.AimbotFOV * 1.25 then
                        return aimLastTarget
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        aimLastTarget = nil
    end
    return nil
end

        local delta = (screenPos - Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, Camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2)).Magnitude
        if delta < Config.AimbotDeadzone then return end
    end
    local jitter = Vector3.new(
        (math.random() - 0.5) * Config.AimbotJitter,
        (math.random() - 0.5) * Config.AimbotJitter,
        0
    )
    Camera.CFrame = Camera.CFrame:Lerp(targetCFrame * CFrame.new(jitter), Config.AimbotSmoothness)
end)
